An original young woman with a high, sleek black
ponytail wears a black blazer over a sheer black
lace bralette. She has layered silver chain
necklaces, a small silver hoop earring, and bold red
lips. Her gaze is directed down and to the side. A
deep blue studio backdrop with soft directional
light. Palette of cobalt, black, and silver. Sharp and
moody, in the style of a cool-toned fashion editorial.
